g.text: COOLING WATER TOWER VER 1 · OTS · ISSUED FOR TEACHING
COOLING WATER SYSTEM — THREE-CELL INDUCED-DRAFT TOWER
1. Flows in m3/h; temperatures in °C; pressures in kPa g. Design case from the simulator model (wet bulb 27 °C).
2. Each cell has a single-speed induced-draft fan (P-212/213/214). Riser valves HS-201/202/203 and bypass HS-204 are motor operated.
3. Filter backwash (P-219, intermittent), caustic, chlorine and biocide dosing details are on the P&ID.
